CheckTitle: Ensure IAM roles do not have full administrative privileges
Description: IAM roles must not have policies granting full administrative privileges (Action: '*' and Resource: '*') unless the role is explicitly designated as a break-glass emergency role with documented justification and strict assumption controls.
Risk: IAM roles with admin privileges grant unrestricted account control to any principal that can assume the role. A misconfigured trust policy or privilege escalation allows an attacker to assume the role and gain full account control.
Remediation: Replace admin policies on roles with scoped policies. For break-glass roles, restrict the trust policy to specific principals with MFA conditions, enable CloudTrail alerting on role assumption, and implement time-limited access.
SeverityBasis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 Control 1.16 (Level 1); roles with admin access are a common escalation target in privilege escalation attack chains
AuthoritativeSource: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0; NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5
